reviews.text: Bought this for myself, but ended up giving it to my Mom as the Minon wash I had given her was almost done and currently unavailable. Upon testing, she had no irritation, and it wasn't drying. Will follow up. BTW, as with many products, it wasn’t totally full.
reviews.zh: 我本來係為咗自己買，但最後送咗俾我媽媽，因為我之前畀佢嘅 Minon 潔面產品快用完，而且而家已經冇貨。佢試用之後冇刺激，亦唔會覺得乾。之後會再跟進。順帶一提，同好多產品一樣，佢嘅樽裝得唔係好滿。

reviews.text: A great gentle cleanser for sensitive skin. It cleanses well without drying out or leaving my skin feeling tight. I have sensitive, reactive skin and this cleanser has never caused any irritation. I use it both morning and evening, and it works perfectly for everyday cleansing. The texture is soft and creamy, and you only need a small amount. Definitely one of the most comfortable cleansers I’ve tried.
reviews.zh: 一款好溫和嘅敏感肌潔面產品。清潔效果好好，唔會令皮膚乾身或者繃緊。我嘅皮膚敏感、易反應，呢款潔面產品從來都冇令我刺激。我早晚都用，日常潔面用起嚟好好。質地柔軟、奶滑，只需要少少份量。絕對係我試過最舒服嘅潔面產品之一。

reviews.text: Sto usando questo detergente da una settimana e ne sono entusiasta. Ho la pelle secca, sensibile e matura. Tutti i detergenti mi tirano la pelle e trovarne che funzionino per me è raro. Questo detergente è favoloso. Pulisce benissimo, strucca bene. Ottimo come doppia detersione o da solo. Ricchissimo di pantenolo, lascia la pelle ben pulita e morbida. Non secca, non tira. La sua texture è cremosa, che diventa una cremina molto fluida a contatto con l'acqua, fa una leggera schiumetta, ma resta essenzialmente in crema. Adoro anche i detergenti contenti soia, questo non è da meno. Delicatissimo, non brucia gli occhi, efficace. Super top!
reviews.zh: 我用呢款潔面產品已經一個星期，非常興奮。我嘅皮膚乾、敏感又成熟。所有潔面產品都會令我皮膚緊繃，所以搵到啱用嘅產品好難得。呢款潔面產品真係好正。清潔效果好好，又可以卸妝。可以當雙重潔面用，亦可以單獨用。含有好多泛醇，令皮膚保持清潔、柔軟。唔會乾，唔會緊。質地係奶霜狀，遇水會變成一款好流動嘅奶霜，會起少少泡，但基本上仍然係奶霜質地。我都好鍾意含豆類成分嘅潔面產品，呢款都唔差。非常溫和，唔會刺痛眼睛，有效。超正！

reviews.text: Un limpiador simple,comparándolo con su limpiador estrella el dokdo cleanser,este no es tan completo en cuanto a hidratación,sin embargo los surfactantes son bastante suaves,es un limpiador cremoso para piel normal a seca,es una opción económica,pero si tienes condiciones de la piel específicas la verdad opta por otro,en lo personal solo busco algo que me limpie sin resecar,este esta bastante bien 🥰
reviews.zh: 一款簡單嘅潔面產品。同佢哋嘅招牌產品 dokdo cleanser 比較，呢款喺補濕方面冇咁全面，但係表面活性劑都幾溫和。係一款適合正常至乾性皮膚嘅奶霜質潔面產品，價錢都抵。但如果你有特定嘅皮膚狀況，我真係建議你揀其他產品。以我個人嚟講，我只係想搵一啲可以清潔又唔會令皮膚乾嘅產品，呢款就幾好 🥰

reviews.text: This cleanser has such a nice texture and creates a rich, soft foam that feels very gentle on the skin. It cleans thoroughly without leaving any dryness or tightness afterward. The panthenol makes it soothing and calming, which is great for sensitive skin. Perfect as a daily cleanser that keeps the skin fresh and comfortable.
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品質地好好，起嘅泡綿密柔軟，對皮膚好溫和。清潔徹底，洗完唔會乾燥或者繃緊。泛醇（panthenol）令佢有舒緩同鎮靜效果，對敏感皮膚好有幫助。非常適合做日常潔面，令皮膚保持清爽舒適。

reviews.text: I love this! I've never seen a texture like this in a cleanser. It comes out like a soft lotion type paste and as soon as it comes in contact with water, it ,elts to a super soft and fluffy foam that glides essortlesly on the skin. It's very moisturising and extremely gentle on my sensitive skin. Round lab is my top brand for cleansers and serums and of course I have already purchased a backup ;)
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！我從未見過咁嘅潔面產品質地。佢擠出嚟係一種軟身乳液型嘅膏狀，一接觸到水就會變成超級柔軟、蓬鬆嘅泡沫，好順滑咁喺皮膚上滑過。非常保濕，對我嘅敏感皮膚超級溫和。Round Lab 係我最愛嘅潔面同精華品牌，當然我已經買咗一個後備 ;)

reviews.text: This cleanser is a dream for sensitive skin days. It’s creamy, soft, and doesn’t strip my face at all. I love that it uses soybean and panthenol—both are so calming and nourishing. After I rinse, my skin doesn’t feel tight or dry, just clean and hydrated. It’s one of the only cleansers I trust when my barrier is feeling a little fragile. It also works great with my other Round Lab products—it’s like they’re made to complement each other. If you’re over harsh foaming cleansers, this one is worth trying.
reviews.zh: 對敏感皮膚嚟講，呢款潔面產品簡直係夢中情品。佢係奶霜質地、軟身，而且完全唔會令我面部乾燥。我好鍾意佢含有大豆同泛醇，兩者都好舒緩、滋養。沖洗之後，皮膚唔會繃緊或者乾燥，只有清潔同水潤嘅感覺。當我嘅皮膚屏障有啲脆弱嗰陣，佢係我少數會信任嘅潔面產品之一。佢同我其他 Round Lab 產品一齊用都好好，好似佢哋專登係為咗互相配合而設計咁。如果你唔再鍾意太刺激嘅泡沫潔面產品，呢款值得一試。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
